[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String

def implementation (string: String) : List Nat :=
  string.foldl (fun (acc: List Nat) (c: Char) =>
    match c with
    | 'o' => 4::acc
    | 'o|' => 2::acc
    | '.|' => 1::acc
    | _ => acc
  ) #::.Nil
|>.reverse
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma foldl_cons
(f: α → β → β)
(b: β)
(xs: List α)
(a: α)
(h: f a (List.foldl f b xs) = b)
: f a (b::xs) = b :=
by
  simp [List.foldl]
  congr
  simp
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation string
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_split := string.splitOn " ";
  have h_result_len := List.length result;
  have h_split_len := h_split.length;
  simp [h_split, h_result_len, h_split_len];
